periods.label: Nov 2 – 8, 2026
periods.headline: AB Enzymes anti-staling launch; cocoa replacers multiply; bird flu hits US egg supply
summary: AB Enzymes launched Veron MaxiFresh, an amylase anti-staling enzyme, and other extended-freshness enzymes were promoted too, a direct competitor move against Puratos freshness improvers; get the specs and benchmark them.
A California bird flu outbreak hit 1.3 million laying hens before the holiday baking rush, so push egg-replacement solutions to US cake and sweet-goods customers now.

Cocoa-saving options are multiplying, with Planet A Foods' cocoa powder replacer, RFINE's coffee-based KAFFIKA extender and pladis's accelerator call for cocoa alternatives, while Barry Callebaut reported sales down 15% and launched a fermentation platform; all are partner or competitor signals for Belcolade.

Clean-label mould inhibition was a recurring theme, and a Brazilian study found kefir-whey and sourdough extended bread mould-free life by 40-70% over yeast bread, supporting Puratos sourdough shelf-life claims.
Regulatory: FDA approved three more natural colour additives and WHO proposed an ultra-processed food profiling model, both pushing customers toward reformulation Puratos can support.

periods.headline: Galy brings cultured cocoa to the US; Oobli and Cosun sugar replacer; FDA opens salt substitutes for bread
summary: Cocoa alternatives reached the market: Galy launched cell-cultured cocoa chocolate in the US and into professional kitchens, putting it in direct reach of Belcolade's chefs and pastry customers.
Start-up Oobli and Cosun Ingredients co-developed a sweet-protein sugar replacer for chocolate, a ready partner or benchmark for sugar-reduced Belcolade lines.

periods.headline: October: cocoa alternatives go to market, Barry Callebaut bets on fermentation, FDA opens salt substitutes
summary: Cocoa was the month's story: Galy launched cultured cocoa in the US, Planet A Foods moved into cocoa powder replacement, and Barry Callebaut launched its Flavourcode fermentation platform, together the biggest set of partner and competitor moves for Belcolade.
Sugar and egg reduction advanced through start-up partnerships, notably Oobli with Cosun on a chocolate sugar replacer and MOA Foodtech with Espiga I+D on bakery egg replacement.
US bakers are pushing fibre and protein (Grupo Bimbo, Calise, Rudi's), and Roquette and Palsgaard launched gluten-free and cake texture ingredients that compete with Puratos mixes and improvers.
Easing cocoa prices and Lindt's price cuts suggest chocolate pricing pressure ahead, so the case for cocoa-saving products needs revisiting as costs fall.

Regulatory: the FDA salt-substitute rule for standardized breads (effective 14 December 2026), a federal synthetic-dye ban bill, California sugar warnings and the push for a federal ultra-processed food definition all point to reformulation demand.
